title: The 'name it' free/no-roll pacify option appeared on nearly every 'armor useless' undead-guard encounter (gray husk, barrow-wight x2, gray sergeant, grave-wight, honour guard) and always worked with zero cost, trivializing what the room textframed as dangerous, mail-piercing threats.
